articles.title: AI Policy
articles.requirement: Establish an AI policy appropriate to the organization's purpose, providing a framework for setting objectives, including commitment to compliance and responsible AI, communicated and available to all relevant parties

articles.title: Responsible AI topics in AI policy
articles.requirement: Address specific responsible AI topics within the policy: fairness, transparency, accountability, human oversight, privacy, safety, and security across the AI system lifecycle

articles.title: Roles and responsibilities for AI
articles.requirement: Define and allocate accountability for all AI-related activities including AIMS ownership, system stewardship, risk management, ethical oversight, and compliance

articles.title: Reporting of AI concerns
articles.requirement: Enable personnel and stakeholders to report AI-related issues, incidents, or ethical concerns through established channels with protection against retaliation

articles.title: Impact of organizational changes
articles.requirement: Assess and manage AI implications during mergers, restructuring, technology transitions, or other significant organizational changes affecting AI systems

articles.title: Resources related to AI systems
articles.requirement: Provision and manage human, technical, financial, and infrastructure resources needed for AI activities throughout the system lifecycle

articles.title: Competencies related to AI systems
articles.requirement: Ensure personnel have required AI competencies through identification of needs, gap analysis, training, and verification of competence

articles.title: Awareness of responsible use of AI systems
articles.requirement: Ensure personnel understand AI policies, risks, ethical considerations, their responsibilities, and mechanisms for reporting concerns

articles.title: Consultation
articles.requirement: Engage internal and external stakeholders in significant AI decisions that may affect individuals or groups, ensuring diverse perspectives are considered

articles.title: Communication about the AI system
articles.requirement: Communicate AI system capabilities, limitations, intended use, and responsible AI commitments to relevant internal and external parties

articles.title: AI system impact assessment process
articles.requirement: Establish a formal, structured process for conducting AI impact assessments throughout the system lifecycle, including triggers for reassessment

articles.title: Documentation of AI system impact assessment
articles.requirement: Document assessment results, methodology, identified impacts, mitigations, and residual risks; maintain and update throughout the AI system lifecycle

articles.title: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups
articles.requirement: Evaluate impacts on individuals and groups including fairness, privacy, safety, security, autonomy, dignity, and potential for discrimination or bias

articles.title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
articles.requirement: Assess broader societal impacts including effects on employment, public trust, social dynamics, environment, economy, democratic processes, and governance

articles.title: Objectives for responsible AI system development
articles.requirement: Establish and document measurable objectives for responsible AI development integrating ethical considerations from inception through deployment and retirement

articles.title: Processes for responsible AI system design and development
articles.requirement: Define documented processes for responsible AI design and development including human oversight requirements and impact assessments at critical lifecycle stages

articles.title: AI system requirements and specification
articles.requirement: Specify and document requirements for new or enhanced AI systems covering functional, performance, fairness, safety, security, and explainability criteria

articles.title: AI system design and development documentation
articles.requirement: Document design decisions, architecture, model selection, training approaches, hyperparameters, and rationale throughout the development process

articles.title: AI system verification and validation
articles.requirement: Confirm systems meet requirements through verification (built correctly) and validation (right system) including functional, bias, security, and robustness testing

articles.title: AI system deployment
articles.requirement: Execute controlled deployment into production with planning, staged rollout, monitoring activation, rollback mechanisms, and stakeholder notification

articles.title: AI system operation and monitoring
articles.requirement: Maintain ongoing performance tracking including accuracy, fairness metrics, drift detection, incident detection, and alignment with intended use during operation

articles.title: AI system technical documentation
articles.requirement: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation of architecture, training data, model parameters, known limitations, operating parameters, and update history

articles.title: AI system recording of event logs
articles.requirement: Record key events, decisions, inputs, outputs, and system changes for audit trails, debugging, explainability, and incident investigation purposes

articles.title: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
articles.requirement: Ensure appropriate data selection, acquisition, and preparation for AI development and enhancement activities with documented criteria and processes

articles.title: Acquisition of data
articles.requirement: Source data responsibly considering consent, privacy, licensing, representativeness, legal and ethical obligations, and potential biases in collection methodology

articles.title: Quality of data for AI systems
articles.requirement: Maintain data accuracy, completeness, relevance, timeliness, and representativeness; identify and address biases; establish data quality metrics and monitoring

articles.title: Data provenance
articles.requirement: Track and document data origin, ownership, transformations, and lineage throughout the data lifecycle enabling traceability and audit

articles.title: Data preparation
articles.requirement: Execute data cleaning, labelling, annotation, transformation, and augmentation activities with documented procedures and quality controls

articles.title: Informing interested parties about AI system interaction
articles.requirement: Notify individuals when they are interacting with an AI system through appropriate disclosure mechanisms proportionate to context and potential impact

articles.title: Informing interested parties about AI outcomes
articles.requirement: Enable stakeholders to understand AI-driven decisions through explanations of key decision factors, logic, and confidence levels appropriate to the audience

articles.title: Access to information about AI system interaction
articles.requirement: Provide access to interaction records, logs, and decision rationale as legally, contractually, or ethically required for affected parties

articles.title: Enabling appropriate human actions in response to AI outputs
articles.requirement: Supply sufficient information to support informed human decision-making, override, escalation, or appeal in response to AI outputs

articles.title: Objectives for responsible use of AI system
articles.requirement: Define measurable objectives for responsible AI use covering security, safety, accessibility, accountability, fairness, reliability, and human oversight

articles.title: Intended use of AI system
articles.requirement: Ensure AI systems are used within intended parameters through usage guidance, constraints, monitoring for misuse, and documented acceptable use boundaries

articles.title: Processes for responsible use of AI system
articles.requirement: Establish operational procedures for AI use including approval workflows, human review requirements, escalation paths, and feedback mechanisms

articles.title: Allocating responsibilities
articles.requirement: Clearly allocate AI-related responsibilities between the organization, partners, suppliers, customers, and third parties with documented accountability frameworks

articles.title: Suppliers of AI system components
articles.requirement: Select, assess, and monitor AI component suppliers for quality, security, ethical standards, certifications, and contractual compliance requirements

articles.title: Provision of AI system to third parties
articles.requirement: Deliver AI systems to third parties responsibly with documentation, intended use guidance, known limitations, support arrangements, and stakeholder communication
